purpose: Freeze the stable NEW Project Check required context, cutover preconditions, and rollback plan without coupling required-check ownership to OLD Project Doctor or to Status Source / Project Status writer transitions.

trigger: project-check required context does not report on PRs targeting main
project-check reports a NEW owning-scope regression after cutover
branch protection becomes unsatisfiable because of context naming or workflow-trigger mismatch
actions: leave OLD Project Doctor implementation intact for rollback observation
do not activate Status Source or Project Status writers as part of rollback

reviews: The live branch-protection endpoint is not readable through the current integration, so current required-context state cannot be re-read directly before a privileged switch.
The legacy pr-guard workflow remains present and observable until a privileged branch-protection switch and post-switch verification are complete.
nextStartPoint: Prove the new project-check job passes on the current migration lineage. If it passes and main remains at the frozen baseline, perform the branch-protection switch using a connection with branch administration permission, then verify project-check is required and pr-guard is no longer required before any writer-ownership transition.
reopenConditions: new required context name or workflow trigger changes
R3 owner or validator contract changes
main SHA changes before branch-protection switch
new project-check job fails on current migration lineage
branch protection exposes a different current required context than the frozen legacy pr-guard evidence
